selection_loss: square errors in DOLLARS, not log-price units
training_objective_warning: Archived model weights were fitted using Huber on log dollars; this reanalysis selects them by USD RMSE but does not claim retraining with USD squared loss.

published_full_xgboost_aggregate_unpaire.caveat: Full model uses more training auctions; not identical training policy or independently per-row paired here.

prevent_catastrophic_errors.note: RMSE penalizes large dollar errors but does not guarantee a maximum error bound; p95/p99/p99.9, top 1pct and $5k/$10k/$20k error rates are tracked independently.
